payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Create an OLED-optimized dark interface with deep black (#000000), dark grey (#121212), midnight blue accents. Use minimal glow effects, vibrant neon accents (green, blue, gold, purple), high contrast text. Optimize for eye comfort and OLED power saving.
payload.best_for: Night-mode apps, coding platforms, entertainment, eye-strain prevention, OLED devices, low-light
payload.css_technical_keywords: background: #000000 or #121212, color: #FFFFFF or #E0E0E0, text-shadow: 0 0 10px neon-color (sparingly), filter: brightness(0.8) if needed, color-scheme: dark
payload.effects_and_animation: Minimal glow (text-shadow: 0 0 10px), dark-to-light transitions, low white emission, high readability, visible focus
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Deep black #000000 or #121212, ☐ Vibrant neon accents used, ☐ Text contrast 7:1+, ☐ Minimal glow effects, ☐ OLED power optimization, ☐ No white (#FFFFFF) background
payload.keywords: Dark theme, low light, high contrast, deep black, midnight blue, eye-friendly, OLED, night mode, power efficient
payload.primary_colors: Deep Black #000000, Dark Grey #121212, Midnight Blue #0A0E27
payload.secondary_colors: Vibrant accents: Neon Green #39FF14, Electric Blue #0080FF, Gold #FFD700, Plasma Purple #BF00FF
